externalSchedule.schedule: 08:00 start plus 5-minute same-task continuation window through 09:55 Asia/Shanghai
outerAgentProtocol: Every wake first uses the read-only status entrypoint. If the exact business date has no run, create one exact run only inside the continuation window. Otherwise reuse the one run_id returned by the workflow SQLite authority; never create a second run.
Run the public entrypoint for that exact run. Read the final compact stdout summary and the exact run-scoped workflow_handoff.json it names; do not depend on one large stdout payload.

Once the public entrypoint child is running, wait for that live process to exit. Do not infer a hang from artifact or file-mtime silence and do not interrupt a live child on that basis; the existing Douyin bounded tail retry may remain silent for 600000ms. The existing total automation execution boundary remains unchanged.

When the public entrypoint reports waiting_stage or waiting_stage_process, end only this bounded outer turn. The same ai-rebuild heartbeat and fixed task wakes again in five minutes, reuses the exact run, and lets the process lock either report truthful waiting or resume the latest committed checkpoint.

When editorial is required, the deterministic public controller starts exactly one fresh bounded Codex child for this exact candidate batch. That child applies only ai-account-editorial-director, sees only the exact candidate evidence, covers every candidate exactly once and returns the existing simple editorial result. It decides standalone eligibility, ranking and candidate-specific reasons without seeing scripts, PM/Dev/QA history or release prose. Each reason cites the candidate's own available fact; do not reuse generic batch reasons. Evidence quantity is not recommendation eligibility, research failure never automatically changes select to observe, and title value, persona fit, and exploration stay separate. The controller validates and commits the result; it does not author editorial content.

When scripts_required is reached, the controller exposes one selected rich Topic Card at a time. Runtime exposes exactly one topic packet containing only exact identity, same-run source facts and fact boundaries. It starts exactly one fresh bounded Codex child for the current topic; that child applies austin-no-overtime-scripting and austin-voice-scriptwriter and may transiently read only the approved Austin private writer authority. It must not see another topic, a previous body, editorial batch deliberation, PM/Dev/QA history or outer automation rules. Private raw text never enters the handoff, checkpoint, DB, final result or Website payload. The child returns one simple script or item-local material_or_angle_insufficiency failure, the controller commits it, and only then exposes the next topic. Submit before the next topic is exposed. No full-batch script submission exists; resume starts at the first unfinished topic without regenerating completed topics.
Run the same public entrypoint with the simple stage result files until local terminal completion.

The owner-only publisher client reads its runtime-only config and attempts one terminal snapshot. Publish pending is not a business failure. Later continuation wakes return terminal noop and never repeat completed upstream stages, Skills, or an applied Website POST.

normalRuntimeForbiddenCalls: recursive codex exec outside the editorial and per-topic writer adapters
